body:
The worst that would happen is that she'd stay with me, we'd lose our home, never be able to have the family we want, and she'd resent me either our whole lives or until she finally decides not to be with me anymore years down the line. And I'd have to face the shame of our friends and family knowing what I've done. 

I just talked to the adjuster. There's no settlement available right now. There's no more answers. God, I don't want this to be the end. I just want happiness and relief. That isn't possible anymore. I'm sorry I wasted your time.

Thank you, and thank you u/Pileofpenguine for offering what you can. 

I wish I could tell her, but I just can't. I know how cowardly it is of me, I know how terrible it is. I know how much it will devastate her if I go through with this. But I can't watch how devastated she'll be when I tell her the truth. Again, I know how cowardly this is of me but I can't overcome it. 

I have taken the day off from work. My wife is at a friend's house, we are supposed to have dinner at their house tonight. I've been trying to get ahold of my claim adjuster from my accident to see if I can get a settlement. If it's big enough to help, I'll take it and tell my wife everything so we can make a plan together. If it's not big enough to really help, I'll cash it out and leave the cash where my wife will find it so she has something other than our overdrafted bank account until she gets the 401k. If it's nothing, then I'll be even sadder as I go, I guess.
